title: Check your tax filing and payment deadlines
text:
What you can do with this tool

 Use this tool to check the deadlines for:

 • Construction Industry Scheme if you are a contractor

 • 
 PAYE if you are an employer

 • Self Assessment

 • VAT

 You will get deadlines based on the information you provide. You will also have the option to print your deadlines or add them to your calendar.

 Calendars you can add to

 You can add your deadlines to most calendar applications on your computer, phone or tablet.

 If you are using this tool on an iPhone or iPad, you will need to use Safari to add your deadlines to Apple Calendar.

 Before you start

 For some taxes you may need to know:

 • your accounting period start and end dates

 • how you pay your tax bill

 • how you send your returns — online or by post

 This tool will take you about 5 minutes to complete.

 You do not need to sign in to use this tool. The information you provide to calculate your deadlines is not sent to HMRC.

 Check now
